options.name: arguments
options.description: Additional arguments for the executable defined in C(src).

options.name: description
options.description: Description for the shortcut. This is usually shown when hoovering the icon.

options.name: dest
options.description: Destination file for the shortcuting file. File name should have a C(.lnk) or C(.url) extension.

options.name: directory
options.description: Working directory for executable defined in C(src).

options.name: hotkey
options.description: Key combination for the shortcut. This is a combination of one or more modifiers and a key. Possible modifiers are Alt, Ctrl, Shift, Ext. Possible keys are [A-Z] and [0-9].

options.name: icon
options.description: Icon used for the shortcut. File name should have a C(.ico) extension. The file name is followed by a comma and the number in the library file (.dll) or use 0 for an image file.

options.name: run_as_admin
options.description: When C(src) is an executable, this can control whether the shortcut will be opened as an administrator or not.

options.name: src
options.description: Executable or URL the shortcut points to. The executable needs to be in your PATH, or has to be an absolute path to the executable.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(absent), removes the shortcut if it exists. When C(present), creates or updates the shortcut.

options.name: windowstyle
options.description: Influences how the application is displayed when it is launched.
